# Application Security Guidance

**← Back to [EAP Home](../../../../README.md) • [Strategy](../../../README.md) • [Guidance](../../README.md) • [Security](../README.md)**

---

This folder contains the TOGAF-aligned architecture guidance set for the **Application Security** capability domain. It covers security architecture for software applications, APIs, containers, and their supporting identity and data protection mechanisms.

---
page_texts.2:
[strategy/guidance/security/Application/README.md#what-this-is]

## What This Is

This content is **architecture guidance** — capability models, Architecture Building Blocks (ABBs), and Reference Architecture Documents (RADs) intended to inform solution design. It is:

<!-- AI-GENERATED-START | user:mygainwell | date:2026-10-22 | model:GitHub Copilot -->
> **Enterprise parent:** Application Security guidance elaborates the [Enterprise Security Architecture Vision](../GUID-SEC-ARCHITECTURE-VISION-0.0.01.md). The Application Security vision remains the immediate parent for this domain's capability, ABB, and RAD documents.
<!-- AI-GENERATED-END | user:mygainwell | date:2026-10-22 -->

- Prescriptive on **architectural intent** (what the enterprise must be able to do)
- Illustrative on **implementation patterns** (how capabilities may be realized)
- Structured for consumption by architects, platform engineering teams, and security reviewers
page_texts.3:
[strategy/guidance/security/Application/README.md#what-this-is-not]

## What This Is NOT

| Not in scope here | Where to find it |
|---|---|
| Security controls, configuration baselines, and enforceable policy | `standards/security/` |
| Security operations procedures and incident response | Security Operations domain guidance |
| Enterprise workforce identity management | Identity Security domain guidance |
| Network-layer DDoS mitigation and perimeter controls | Network Security domain guidance |
